name: NGC 3423, AT 2019ahd field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3423, a spiral galaxy that hosted the stellar outburst AT 2019ahd, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2019ahd-hubble
story: In 2019 a star in this spiral galaxy flared up as AT 2019ahd, first taken for a luminous blue variable and later shown to be an intermediate-luminosity red transient. Hubble looked back at the site of the outburst.

claims.text: AT 2019ahd lies in the spiral galaxy NGC 3423
AT 2019ahd was initially classified as a luminous blue variable and later shown to be an intermediate-luminosity red transient (ILRT)
Blast lists 2019ahd as LBV in host NGC3423 at the program's pointing
SN2019AHD is a target of Hubble program 16239 on nearby, recent supernovae
